AI and Machine Learning

Practical AI, built for production.

We build generative AI applications, retrieval systems, agents, and machine learning models around a specific business problem, then test them against real examples before they reach your users.

Discuss Your ProjectHow we work

Capabilities

  • Retrieval-augmented generation
  • AI agents and automation
  • Document and data extraction
  • Predictive models
  • Evaluation and monitoring
  • AI features in your product

What we deliver

Focused capabilities, delivered by experienced engineers.

  • Retrieval-augmented generation

    Assistants that answer from your documents and systems, cite their sources, and respect existing access permissions.

  • AI agents and automation

    Agents that use your tools and APIs to complete multistep tasks, with human approval where judgment or risk requires it.

  • Document and data extraction

    Pipelines that turn contracts, forms, email, and records into structured data your team can search, review, and use.

  • Predictive models

    Forecasting, classification, and scoring models built on your data and designed around the decisions they support.

  • Evaluation and monitoring

    Evaluation sets drawn from your workflow, quality and safety checks, and production monitoring so performance is measured, not assumed.

  • AI features in your product

    AI capabilities added to existing applications through well-defined APIs, with cost, latency, and fallback behavior designed in.

When teams bring us in

Common starting points.

  • You have a promising AI prototype that is not reliable enough to ship.
  • Teams spend hours searching documents or re-keying information between systems.
  • You want AI features in your product that are accurate, observable, and affordable to run.
  • Leadership wants a candid view of where AI will and will not help the business.

What you can expect

  • A working AI system integrated with your environment
  • Evaluation datasets and results you can rerun
  • Prompts, retrieval, and model configuration under version control
  • Monitoring, feedback, and escalation workflows
  • Documentation of known limits, risks, and operating costs

Our approach

From first conversation to production.

  1. 01

    Define the task

    The decision or workflow, the data available, and what a useful result looks like, agreed with the people who do the work.

  2. 02

    Build an evaluation set

    Real examples, edge cases, and known failure modes, assembled before any tuning so progress can be measured.

  3. 03

    Iterate against evidence

    Prompts, retrieval, models, and guardrails measured against the evaluation set in every iteration.

  4. 04

    Deploy with oversight

    Monitoring, feedback capture, human review where it matters, and a clear way for users to flag mistakes.

Questions

Common questions.

More answers on our FAQ page.

What AI work do you take on?

Applications built on large language models, including assistants, retrieval-augmented generation, and agents, along with document and data pipelines and predictive models. Each is tested against real examples from your work.

How do you know the AI is working well enough?

We define success criteria with your team, build an evaluation set from your workflow, and measure each version against it. We review results with you before launch and monitor them afterward.

Can the AI run on our own infrastructure?

That depends on the model and your environment. We review the options with you and follow your data handling and hosting requirements.

Which models do you use?

We select models based on measured accuracy on your evaluation set, data handling requirements, latency, and cost, and we design systems so the model can be changed later.
